thread:
Olivia Park: Quick policy question— Im returning from parental leave on Jan 3 but my childs follow-up appointments mean Id like Jan 2 and Jan 4 off. Jan 2 is inside the year-end PTO blackout. I also have one floating holiday (Winter Solstice) that I havent used. Can managers swap the floating holiday into Jan 2 so its not blocked by the blackout, or is that only for scheduling earlier in the year?
Diego (People Ops): Hi Olivia — congrats on the new baby! Short answer: floating holidays are considered discretionary time off and normally subject to the blackout if taken during the blackout window. However, we do allow one-off swaps for return-from-leave accommodations where a manager approves and People Ops signs off.
Olivia Park: Awesome, thanks. Marcus (my manager) is fine with it. Marcus, can you confirm here?
Marcus Lee: Confirmed — I approve swapping Olivias Winter Solstice floating holiday to cover Jan 2. No impact to team deliverables.
Diego (People Ops): Great. Process steps: 1) Manager approval in thread (done). 2) Employee files the "Floating Holiday Swap" form (internal link): https://intranet.redwood/hr/forms/floating-swap. 3) People Ops will tag the request as "return accommodation" and bypass blackout for that single day. Payroll will then code the day as Floating Holiday rather than PTO.
Suki (Payroll): FYI for payroll: once People Ops flags the request, well post the floating holiday paycode. If the employee is on partial pay during transition from leave to active, payroll/payroll ops needs to confirm proration. For US-based employees this code does not impact tax withholding. If youre out of country during the day, loop Legal.
Olivia Park: Im US-based and will be working part of Jan 3. Good to know. Any ETA on turnaround? Id like to confirm childcare.
Diego (People Ops): Typical turnaround is 2 business days after the form and manager approval are submitted. Well update the ticket and cc you.
Nadia (Legal): Quick flag — managers should avoid pattern-based exceptions that could create inconsistent accommodation exposure across regions. People Ops, please track these as "medical/parental accommodation swaps" for audit.
Olivia Park: Filed the floating-swap form and attached Marcuss approval screenshot. Link: https://intranet.redwood/hr/req/FH-2026-77
HR-Bot: Ticket HR-2026-1845 created for Olivia Park — floating holiday swap request received.
Suki (Payroll): Thanks Olivia — queued for processing. Expect update in 2 business days.
Diego (People Ops): All set from People Ops side once payroll posts the code. Olivia — if you need Jan 4 as PTO and your balance is low, we can discuss a short PTO advance as well.
Olivia Park: Appreciate it everyone, that should do it. :heart: 
Marcus Lee: Thanks, team.
Diego (People Ops): Closing loop once payroll confirms; will leave ticket open until posted.
